name: page
title: Page
description: One page of a document: where it is, and what it is about by its own headings. Its words are read from the document, by page.

files.api/service.yaml:
# THE PAGE'S FUNCTIONS (docs/unoverse/data/objects/README.md 4b). A page's row says where it is;
# its words are read with its document's getDetail and `pages` (page-store.md), so the words are
# read in one place only.
getDetail:
  description: The page's row, which says its document and its page number. Read its words with the document's getDetail and pages.
  returns: "{{ row }}"

# ON THE MAP LIKE EVERY ROW (page-store.md, one index, 2026-10-07), so listed like every row:
# the same function a need's rows offer, unchanged.
# EVERY ROW WHOSE FIELD HOLDS A VALUE. A question across rows ("which funds use this
# administrator?", "which managers are regulated here?") is a filter on the object's own fields,
# not a search: a search is ranked and cut off and answers with the rows it happened to rank.
# Asked of any row, it reads every row of that row's object in the org; the row it was called on
# says which object, and nothing more.
list:
  description: >-
    Every row of this kind whose own field holds a value, with that field and its citations: which
    funds use an administrator, which managers are regulated somewhere, which documents are of a
    type. A complete list, never ranked: for any question that asks which, how many or all of
    something with a property, call this on one row of that kind and answer from it, never from
    search rows.
  input:
    type: object
    required: [field, value]
    properties:
      field:
        type: string
        enum: props
        description: The field to look in, by its own name
      value:
        type: string
        description: >-
          What the field holds. Matched anywhere in the field, a list's members included, and
          regardless of case
  calls:
    - name: found
      node: DatasetQuery
      config:
        object: "return String(row.object_type || '')"
        org: "{{ row.org }}"
        where: "return [{ column: String(params.field), contains: String(params.value) }]"
        limit: 200
  returns:
    rows: "return (calls.found && calls.found.rows) || []"
    count: "return ((calls.found && calls.found.rows) || []).length"
files.page.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
type: object
name: page
element: content
icon: file-text
meta: open

# ONE PAGE OF A DOCUMENT (docs/unoverse/data/objects/page-store.md). NOT IN SPATIAL (owner,
# 2026-10-08): no `embed`. A page is reached from the needs read from it (`readFrom`), and every
# page with content gives at least one need. Its words are kept ONCE, in the page store, with a
# word index; this row holds where it is (its document, by `partOf`, and its page number), never a
# copy. Written by the page store when a document is read, never by a model. The words are read
# with the document's getDetail and `pages`.
search: [universal_id, object_type, title, description, source_url, source_id]

title: Page
description: >-
  One page of a document: where it is, and what it is about by its own headings. Its words are
  read from the document, by page.
whenToUse: >-
  Find the page of a document that holds the words a question needs, when no need was read
  from that page. Read it with its document's getDetail and its page number.
category: Objects
version: 1.0.0

props: { $include: props }
files.props.yaml:
# A PAGE'S FIELDS. Every one is written by the page store when its document is read, never by the
# model (input: false). The page's words are not a field: they are kept once, in the page store.
universal_id:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The row's permanent handle, minted from the document's id and the page number, so a re-read finds the same row.
title:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The document's title and the page number, as "Offering Memorandum, page 41".
description:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The page's own headings, as one contents line; empty when the page has none.
org:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The organisation whose row this is. Assigned by the run.
source_url:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The file the page is in, the same address as its document.
source_id:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The file's source id, the same as its document's.
partId:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The page's id within its document, its page number as text.
page:
  type: number
  input: false
  description: The page number, counted from 1, as the document's reading marks it.
